title: Ovo cozido perfeito
creator: bettoauge
steps: Bring the water to a full boil before adding the eggs. Works with eggs straight from the fridge or at room temperature.
Cook 6 minutes for a soft yolk, 8 minutes for firm but creamy (his favourite), 10 minutes for firm.
Follow the cooling and peeling steps shown in the video. He says every step matters for easy peeling.
